headline: Tera Software publishes its share capital audit for the second quarter of financial year 2027.
summary: Tera Software has released its share capital audit report for Q2 FY27. The routine filing details the company's capital structure for the quarter. Such procedural disclosures are standard regulatory requirements for listed entities. Retail investors in small-cap stocks should review fundamental metrics rather than relying solely on compliance filings.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on stock price

headline: Tera Software files SEBI depository compliance certificate for Q2 2026
summary: Tera Software has submitted its SEBI depository compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal 2026. This is a routine regulatory filing required for listed companies. Indian retail investors holding the stock can note the compliance completion, though it carries no direct financial impact on earnings.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no direct financial impact.
